# ASSET PROPERTIES (@asset_properties17)
> Institutional-grade private real estate advisory platform in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Auditing, rejecting, and curating ultra-luxury flats, landed duplex villas, and Grade-A commercial spaces.

## Core Advisory Chambers
- [Sanctuary Home](https://assetproperties.in): Institutional real estate underwriting overview and 5-act interactive audit.
- [Advisory Realms](https://assetproperties.in/realms): Curated portfolio across Sky Sanctuaries (Luxury Flats), Landed Estates (Duplex Villas), and Commercial Monoliths.
- [Philosophy of Refusal](https://assetproperties.in/refusal): Forensic disqualification dossiers for 114 rejected projects in Bhubaneswar (Kissam defects, flood risks, non-ORERA marketing).
- [The 100-Point Asset Score™ X-Ray](https://assetproperties.in/xray): Proprietary 5-pillar mathematical underwriting matrix with Leica laser carpet audits.
- [Odisha Financial Lab](https://assetproperties.in/calculus): True-Cost calculus, Odisha Stamp Duty & IGR fee calculators (Male 7% vs Female 6%), and commercial rent-to-wealth converter.
- [The Private Vault](https://assetproperties.in/vault): Confidential pre-launch mandates, off-market generational plots, and VIP Golden-Hour site-visit concierge.

## Key Facts & Institutional Benchmarks
- **Location:** Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India (Operating in Patia, Infocity, Pahala, Hanspal, Trisulia, Saheed Nagar, Kalinga Nagar, Jayadev Vihar).
- **Audit Volume:** 142 Projects Audited • 114 Disqualified (80% Refusal Rate) • 28 Approved Mandates.
- **Title Clearance:** 100% Gharabari status verified via 30+ year Bhulekh Record of Rights (RoR) title chains.
- **RERA Statutory Compliance:** Every approved project holds full ORERA registration and BDA sanctioned plans.
- **Odisha Stamp Duty:** 7% for male buyers, 6% for female buyers, plus 2% IGR Odisha registration fee.
- **Contact & Concierge:** Direct advisory via Instagram [@asset_properties17](https://instagram.com/asset_properties17) and verified WhatsApp dossier vault.
